question: A tank is 25 m long, 12 m wide and 6 m deep. The cost (in Rs) of plastering its walls and bottom at Rs. 10 per m² is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Plastering Area = Area of bottom + Area of 4 walls

⇒ Area = (l × b) + 2h(l + b)

⇒ Area = (25 × 12) + 2 × 6 × (25 + 12)

⇒ Area = 300 + 12 × 37 = 744 m²

Cost = 744 × 10 = 7440

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7440.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 25 m, Width (b) = 12 m, Depth (h) = 6 m

Rate of plastering = ₹10 per m²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cb232acf81154e5b06aa3e0e4a3f9d44db247e0c56fe1ff0075964decf4230e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Area of 4 walls = Lateral Surface Area = 2h(l + b)

Area of bottom = l × b

Total area to be plastered = 2h(l + b) + (l × b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 2 × 6 × (25 + 12)

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 12 × 37 = 444 m²

⇒ Area of bottom = 25 × 12 = 300 m²

⇒ Total area = 444 + 300 = 744 m²

⇒ Total cost = 744 × 10 = 7440

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7440.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total surface area includes all 6 faces: TSA = 2(lb + bh + lh).

Volume of a Cuboid

The total space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as: Volume = l × b × h.

Longest Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest pole that can be placed in a room is its diagonal: d = √(l² + b² + h²).

fa:T
